zh: 遵守（abide by）；容忍（多用於否定）
def: To accept and follow a rule, decision or agreement; also to tolerate something.
接受並遵守規定、決定或協議；也指忍受某事。
ex: All contractors must abide by the safety rules on site.
所有承包商都必須遵守現場的安全規定。
Employees who fail to abide by the dress code may be sent home.
未遵守服裝規定的員工可能會被請回家。
Both companies agreed to abide by the arbitrator's decision.
兩家公司都同意遵守仲裁人的裁決。
Our manager cannot abide careless mistakes in client reports.
我們經理無法容忍客戶報告中的粗心錯誤。
Guests are asked to abide by the hotel's quiet hours after ten p.m.
請住客遵守飯店晚上十點後的安靜時段規定。

family.zh: 持久的（如 an abiding interest）

note: Also followed by with; slightly more formal and common in legal or regulatory contexts.
後面接 with；稍微更正式，常見於法規情境。
Obey takes a person or order as object; abide by is used for rules and agreements.
obey 的受詞是人或命令；abide by 用於規定與協議。

zh: 吸收；承擔（費用）；使專注；併入
def: To take in liquid, information or shock; to bear a cost; to make something part of a larger whole.
吸入液體、資訊或衝擊；承擔費用；把較小的事物併入較大者。
ex: The company decided to absorb the shipping costs rather than raise prices.
公司決定自行吸收運費，而不調漲價格。
Trainees absorb a great deal of information during their first week.
受訓人員在第一週吸收了大量資訊。
The thick carpet helps absorb noise from the open-plan office.
厚地毯有助於吸收開放式辦公室的噪音。
After the merger, the smaller firm was absorbed into the parent company.
合併後，規模較小的公司被併入母公司。
She was so absorbed in the budget report that she missed lunch.
她太專注於預算報告，連午餐都錯過了。

note: Informal and often literal (liquid) or figurative (atmosphere); absorb is more neutral and formal.
較口語，可指吸水或感受氣氛；absorb 較中性、正式。
Formal; to take in ideas or people and make them fully part of a group or one's own knowledge.
較正式；指把想法或人完全融入群體或自己的知識中。

def: The act of agreeing to take something offered, or general approval of an idea.
同意收下所提供之物的行為，或對某想法的普遍認可。
ex: Please sign the form as your formal acceptance of the job offer.
請簽署這份表格，作為你正式接受這份工作邀約的證明。
The new pricing plan has gained wide acceptance among our customers.
新的定價方案已廣受我們的客戶接受。
Her acceptance of the award was followed by a short speech.
她領獎後發表了一段簡短的致詞。
Final acceptance of the building depends on the inspector's report.
這棟建築物最終能否驗收取決於檢查員的報告。
The supplier sent a letter of acceptance within two days of our order.
供應商在我們下訂單兩天內寄來了接受函。

note: Approval means permission from someone in authority; acceptance means agreeing to take what is offered.
approval 是有權者的許可；acceptance 是同意收下所提供的東西。

zh: 可到達的；可取得的；易懂的；無障礙的
def: Easy to reach, enter, obtain or understand.
容易抵達、進入、取得或理解的。
ex: The conference centre is easily accessible by train and bus.
會議中心搭火車和公車都很容易到達。
All entrances are wheelchair accessible.
所有入口都有輪椅無障礙設施。
The report uses plain language to make the data accessible to non-specialists.
這份報告用淺顯的語言，讓非專業人士也能看懂這些數據。
Files in this folder are accessible only to the finance team.
這個資料夾中的檔案只有財務團隊才能存取。
Our manager is friendly and accessible, so staff often drop by with questions.
我們的經理親切又容易接近，所以員工常順道來問問題。

note: Available means able to be obtained or used; accessible stresses how easy it is to reach or enter.
available 指能取得或使用；accessible 強調容易抵達或進入。
Used for people who are friendly and easy to talk to.
用來形容親切、容易交談的人。

ant.zh: 無法到達的、無法取得的

note: Acceptable means good enough; accessible means easy to reach or use.
acceptable 是「夠好、可接受」；accessible 是「容易到達或使用」。

def: A person whose job is to keep or check financial records and prepare tax returns.
負責記帳或查核財務紀錄並辦理報稅的專業人員。
ex: Our accountant prepares the tax return every March.
我們的會計師每年三月辦理報稅。
The firm is hiring a senior accountant to join the finance team.
公司正在招募一名資深會計加入財務團隊。
Ask your accountant whether the expense can be deducted.
請問你的會計師這筆費用能否扣除。
She trained as a certified public accountant before moving into consulting.
她先受訓成為註冊會計師，之後才轉入顧問業。
The accountant sent a summary of the quarterly figures to the board.
會計人員把季度數字的摘要寄給了董事會。

note: A bookkeeper records daily transactions; an accountant analyses the figures, reports and gives financial advice.
bookkeeper 負責記錄日常交易；accountant 則分析數字、出報告並提供財務建議。
An auditor independently checks the accounts an accountant prepares.
auditor 獨立查核會計人員所做的帳目。

def: To follow a rule or plan closely; to stick firmly to a surface.
嚴格遵循規定或計畫；牢牢黏在表面上。
ex: All staff must adhere to the company's data protection policy.
所有員工都必須遵守公司的資料保護政策。
We will adhere to the schedule unless the client asks for changes.
除非客戶要求更動，否則我們會按照時程進行。
The label will not adhere to a wet or dusty surface.
標籤無法黏在潮濕或有灰塵的表面上。
The committee has adhered to the same hiring principles for years.
委員會多年來都堅持相同的聘雇原則。
Drivers who adhere strictly to the speed limit rarely receive fines.
嚴格遵守速限的駕駛人很少被罰款。

note: Comply with is followed by rules or requests; adhere to suggests sticking firmly to a plan or principle.
comply with 後接規定或要求；adhere to 暗示堅定遵循計畫或原則。
Abide by is used for accepting and following rules or decisions.
abide by 用於接受並遵守規定或決定。

zh: 顧問性的；諮詢的；（官方）警示、公告
def: Giving advice rather than making decisions; an official notice that warns people about something.
提供建議而非做決定的；向大眾發出警示的官方通知。
ex: She sits on the advisory board of two local start-ups.
她擔任兩家本地新創公司的顧問委員。
The government issued a travel advisory for the region after the storm.
暴風雨過後，政府針對該地區發布了旅遊警示。
He works as an advisory consultant on pension plans.
他擔任退休金計畫的諮詢顧問。
A weather advisory warned drivers to avoid the mountain road.
天氣警示提醒駕駛人避開山路。
The committee plays a purely advisory role and cannot make final decisions.
這個委員會只扮演諮詢角色，無法做最終決定。

note: Formal; describes a group or process that gives advice or asks for opinions before a decision.
較正式；形容在決策前提供意見或徵詢意見的團體或過程。
Advisable means wise to do; advisory means giving advice or a warning.
advisable 是「明智、值得做」；advisory 是「提供建議或警示」。

def: A place where aircraft take off and land and passengers wait for flights.
飛機起降、旅客候機的場所。
ex: The shuttle bus leaves for the airport every thirty minutes.
接駁巴士每三十分鐘開往機場。
Please arrive at the airport two hours before an international flight.
國際航班請在起飛前兩小時抵達機場。
Our flight was delayed because of fog at the airport.
我們的班機因機場起霧而延誤。
The hotel offers a free airport pickup for guests who book directly.
直接訂房的住客可享免費機場接送。
Airport security was tighter than usual this morning.
今天早上機場的安檢比平常更嚴格。

zh: 走道、通道（座位或貨架之間）
def: A narrow passage between rows of seats or shelves.
座位或貨架排列之間的狹窄通道。
ex: I prefer an aisle seat so I can stretch my legs.
我偏好走道座位，這樣可以伸展雙腿。
The cleaning products are in aisle seven, next to the paper goods.
清潔用品在第七走道，紙製品旁邊。
Please keep the aisle clear in case of an emergency.
請保持走道暢通，以防緊急狀況。
The flight attendant pushed the drinks cart down the aisle.
空服員推著飲料推車走過走道。
Staff restock the shelves along each aisle before the store opens.
員工在開店前補滿每條走道旁的貨架。

note: A corridor connects rooms inside a building; an aisle runs between rows of seats or shelves.
corridor 連接建築物內的房間；aisle 位於成排座位或貨架之間。
Any path for walking, often outdoors or raised; aisle is inside a vehicle, shop or hall.
供行走的任何通道，常在戶外或架高；aisle 則在車內、店內或大廳內。
Pronounced the same as aisle but means a small island.
發音與 aisle 相同，但意思是小島。

zh: 警報、通知；使警覺、通知；警覺的
def: A warning message; to warn someone about a problem; watchful and ready to act.
警告訊息；就問題向某人提出警告；留心且隨時準備行動的。
ex: The system sends an alert whenever stock drops below ten units.
只要庫存低於十件，系統就會發出警示。
Please alert security if you see an unattended bag.
如果看到無人看管的包包，請通知保全。
Drivers should stay alert on long night shifts.
夜間長時間駕駛的司機應保持警覺。
The bank alerted customers to a new email scam.
銀行提醒客戶注意一種新的電子郵件詐騙。
A weather alert was issued for the coastal area.
沿海地區發布了天氣警報。

note: Warn stresses danger; alert stresses making someone aware so they can act.
warn 強調危險；alert 強調讓人察覺以便採取行動。
Neutral and formal; informs someone officially, without implying urgency.
中性且正式；正式告知，不一定帶有緊急感。
Formal adjective; watchful for danger over a period of time.
較正式的形容詞；長時間留意危險。
An alarm is a loud signal of danger; an alert is a message or notice.
alarm 是示警的巨響訊號；alert 是訊息或通知。

def: A medical condition in which the body reacts badly to a food, plant or substance.
身體對食物、植物或物質產生不良反應的病症。
ex: Please tell the restaurant about any food allergies when you book.
訂位時請告知餐廳任何食物過敏。
He has an allergy to peanuts, so he checks every label.
他對花生過敏，所以每個標籤都會檢查。
Seasonal allergies caused several staff to take sick leave.
季節性過敏使幾位員工請了病假。
The nurse asked whether the patient had any drug allergies.
護理師詢問病人是否有任何藥物過敏。
Employees with a severe allergy should carry their medication at all times.
有嚴重過敏的員工應隨身攜帶藥物。

note: Food intolerance is a digestive reaction; an allergy involves the immune system and can be more dangerous.
食物不耐是消化反應；過敏牽涉免疫系統，可能更危險。

def: A machine for use in the home or office, such as an oven or a washing machine.
家中或辦公室使用的機器，例如烤箱或洗衣機。
ex: The store sells kitchen appliances such as ovens and dishwashers.
這家店販售烤箱和洗碗機等廚房電器。
Please unplug every electrical appliance before you leave the office.
離開辦公室前，請拔掉所有電器的插頭。
This appliance comes with a two-year manufacturer's warranty.
這台電器附有兩年的原廠保固。
Energy-efficient appliances can lower a household's monthly electricity bill.
節能電器可以降低家庭每月的電費。
The technician will repair the faulty appliance on Thursday.
技師將在週四修理這台故障的電器。

note: Device is broader and covers any piece of equipment, especially electronic; appliance is for home or kitchen machines.
device 範圍較廣，指任何設備，尤其電子產品；appliance 多指家用或廚房機器。
A small, clever or novel device; informal.
小巧或新奇的裝置；口語。
An applicant is a person who applies for a job or service; an appliance is a machine.
applicant 是申請工作或服務的人；appliance 是機器。

def: A person who formally asks for a job, loan, place or permit.
正式申請工作、貸款、名額或許可的人。
ex: Every applicant must submit a résumé and two references.
每位應徵者都必須繳交履歷表和兩份推薦信。
The firm received more than two hundred applicants for the position.
這個職缺收到了兩百多位應徵者。
Successful applicants will be contacted by phone within a week.
錄取的應徵者會在一週內接到電話通知。
The loan applicant was asked to provide proof of income.
貸款申請人被要求提供收入證明。
Each visa applicant needs a valid passport.
每位簽證申請人都需要有效護照。

note: A candidate is someone being considered for a job or election, often after screening; an applicant is anyone who has applied.
candidate 是被考慮的人選，常已經過篩選；applicant 是任何提出申請的人。
An appliance is a machine; an applicant is a person who applies.
appliance 是機器；applicant 是申請人。

def: The putting together of parts to make something; a meeting of a large group of people.
把零件組合成產品；眾人的集會。
ex: The assembly of the engine takes about four hours.
組裝這具引擎大約需要四小時。
Workers on the assembly line check each part for defects.
裝配線上的工人逐一檢查每個零件有無瑕疵。
Please read the assembly instructions before you start building the shelf.
開始組裝書架前，請先閱讀組裝說明。
The whole school gathered in the hall for the morning assembly.
全校師生聚集在禮堂參加晨間集會。
The city's legislative assembly will vote on the budget next week.
市議會將於下週就預算案進行表決。

note: Informal and general for any group of people; assembly is more formal or official.
泛指任何聚集的人群，較口語；assembly 較正式或官方。

zh: 任務、工作指派；作業；外派
def: A piece of work given to someone in a job or course; a posting to a particular place.
指派給某人的工作或課業；被派往特定地點或職務。
ex: Our team received a new assignment from the head office on Monday.
我們團隊週一從總公司接到一項新任務。
She was sent to the Bangkok branch on a six-month assignment.
她被派到曼谷分公司，為期六個月。
Please submit the assignment by Friday at noon.
請在週五中午前繳交作業。
The assignment of seats will be done at check-in.
座位會在報到時分配。
The reporter's first assignment was covering the trade fair.
這位記者的第一項任務是採訪貿易展。

note: A task is one piece of work; an assignment is a task given to you by someone, often with a deadline.
task 是一項工作；assignment 是別人交付給你的工作，通常有期限。
A duty is an ongoing responsibility of a job; an assignment is usually a specific piece of work.
duty 是職務上持續的責任；assignment 通常是特定的工作項目。

zh: 服務人員、侍者；隨之而來的
def: A person whose job is to serve or help the public in a place; accompanying or resulting from something.
在某處為大眾服務或提供協助的人；伴隨某事而來的。
ex: A flight attendant showed passengers where the emergency exits are.
空服員向乘客說明緊急出口的位置。
The parking attendant gave us a ticket at the gate.
停車場管理員在閘門口給了我們一張停車券。
Please ask the museum attendant if you need help finding the exhibit.
如果需要協助尋找展品，請詢問博物館的服務人員。
The pool attendant checks the water temperature every hour.
泳池管理員每小時檢查一次水溫。
The new policy has several attendant risks that must be reviewed.
這項新政策伴隨著幾項必須檢討的風險。

note: An attendee is a person who attends an event; an attendant works at a place to serve people.
attendee 是出席活動的人；attendant 是在某處服務他人的工作人員。

def: A person who is present at an event such as a meeting, conference or class.
出席會議、研討會或課程等活動的人。
ex: Each attendee will receive a name badge at registration.
每位與會者在報到時都會領到名牌。
More than three hundred attendees signed up for the workshop.
超過三百人報名了這場工作坊。
Attendees are asked to silence their phones during the keynote.
主題演講期間，請與會者將手機轉為靜音。
The organiser emailed all conference attendees a copy of the schedule.
主辦單位把議程表寄給了所有研討會與會者。
Lunch is provided for attendees of the full-day seminar.
全天研討會的出席者可享用午餐。

note: A participant takes an active part in an event; an attendee is simply present.
participant 積極參與活動；attendee 只是出席。
A delegate is an official representative sent to a meeting by a group.
delegate 是團體派往會議的正式代表。
An attendant provides service at a place; an attendee goes to an event.
attendant 在某處提供服務；attendee 是前往參加活動的人。

zh: 稽核員、審計人員、查帳員
def: A person who officially examines a company's financial records to check they are accurate.
正式檢查公司財務紀錄是否正確的人。
ex: An external auditor will review our accounts next month.
外部審計人員下個月會審查我們的帳目。
The auditor found several errors in the expense reports.
審計人員在費用報告中發現了幾處錯誤。
The company hired a new auditor after the merger.
合併後，公司聘請了新的審計人員。
Our internal auditor reports directly to the board.
我們的內部稽核人員直接向董事會報告。
The auditor's report was published with the annual results.
審計報告與年度業績一同公布。

note: An inspector checks quality, safety or rules; an auditor checks financial records.
inspector 檢查品質、安全或規定；auditor 檢查財務紀錄。
An accountant prepares the records; an auditor independently checks them.
accountant 製作帳務；auditor 獨立查核。

zh: 權力、職權；當局；權威（人士）
def: The official right to make decisions or give orders; an official organisation in charge of something; an expert.
做決定或下命令的正式權力；負責管理某事的官方機構；專家。
ex: Only the finance director has the authority to approve this expense.
只有財務長有權核准這筆費用。
The local authorities issued a permit for the outdoor event.
地方當局為這場戶外活動核發了許可。
She is a leading authority on supply chain management.
她是供應鏈管理領域的權威。
The airport authority announced new security procedures.
機場管理局宣布了新的安檢程序。
Managers were given more authority over staffing decisions.
經理們獲得了更多人事決策的權限。

note: Power is the general ability to act or influence; authority is the official right to do so.
power 是一般的行事或影響能力；authority 是官方賦予的權利。
Formal and legal; the area or subject over which an official body has authority.
正式的法律用語；指機構擁有管轄權的範圍或事項。

def: To make a process or machine work automatically with little or no human control.
使流程或機器在幾乎不需人工控制下自動運作。
ex: The company plans to automate its invoicing process next year.
公司計畫明年將開立發票的流程自動化。
We automated the weekly report, which saves two hours of manual work.
我們把每週報告自動化，省下兩小時的人工作業。
Many banks have automated routine customer enquiries with chatbots.
許多銀行用聊天機器人自動處理例行的客戶詢問。
Factories that automate packaging can ship orders faster.
將包裝自動化的工廠可以更快出貨。
Repetitive tasks are the easiest to automate.
重複性的工作最容易自動化。

note: Older word; to replace human labour with machines, while automate often means software or self-operating systems.
較舊的用語；指以機器取代人力，而 automate 常指軟體或自動運作系統。
To start using computers to do a job or store records.
開始使用電腦處理工作或儲存紀錄。

def: Working by itself without direct human control; happening as a normal result.
無需人直接操控、自行運作的；作為正常結果自然發生的。
ex: The doors have an automatic sensor that opens them as you approach.
這些門有自動感應器，人一靠近就會開啟。
You will receive an automatic reply if the manager is out of the office.
如果經理不在辦公室，你會收到自動回覆。
Enrolment in the pension plan is automatic for all full-time staff.
所有全職員工都會自動加入退休金計畫。
Set up an automatic payment so your bill is never late.
設定自動付款，帳單就不會逾期。
Renewal is not automatic; you must reapply every year.
續約不是自動的，你每年都必須重新申請。

note: Autonomous means able to act or govern itself independently, such as a self-driving car; automatic means working by itself once set up.
autonomous 指能獨立行動或自治，如自駕車；automatic 指設定後自行運作。

def: A small card or piece of metal that shows who you are or where you work.
顯示身分或工作單位的小卡片或金屬片。
ex: Please wear your badge at all times while you are in the building.
在大樓內請隨時配戴識別證。
Swipe your badge at the gate to enter the parking garage.
請在閘門刷識別證進入停車場。
Visitors collect a name badge from reception.
訪客在接待處領取名牌。
The security guard asked to see my ID badge.
保全人員要求查看我的識別證。
He lost his badge and had to ask the front desk for a temporary one.
他弄丟了識別證，只好向櫃檯申請一張臨時證。

note: A pass is a document or card giving permission to enter, often temporary; a badge also identifies the wearer.
pass 是允許進入的證件或卡片，常為臨時性；badge 還能辨識配戴者身分。

def: A large formal meal for many guests, held for a special occasion.
為特殊場合舉辦、賓客眾多的正式大型餐會。
ex: The company will hold its annual banquet at a downtown hotel.
公司將在市區一家飯店舉辦年度宴會。
Over two hundred guests attended the awards banquet.
兩百多位賓客出席了頒獎晚宴。
A farewell banquet was given for the retiring director.
公司為即將退休的主任舉辦了惜別宴。
Tickets for the charity banquet include a three-course meal.
慈善晚宴的門票包含三道菜的餐點。
The hotel's banquet hall can seat up to five hundred people.
這家飯店的宴會廳最多可容納五百人。

note: A feast is a very large, often joyful meal; a banquet is formal and carefully organised.
feast 是豐盛且常帶歡樂氣氛的大餐；banquet 較正式且經過精心安排。
A special formal social event, not always a meal; often for raising money.
特別的正式社交活動，不一定有用餐；常為募款而辦。

def: A device that stores electrical energy and powers phones, cars and other equipment.
儲存電能、為手機、汽車等設備供電的裝置。
ex: The laptop battery lasts about eight hours on a single charge.
這台筆電的電池充一次電可使用約八小時。
Please replace the battery in the smoke detector every year.
請每年更換煙霧偵測器的電池。
My phone ran out of battery during the presentation.
簡報進行到一半，我的手機沒電了。
The new electric bus has a rechargeable battery with a long range.
這款新電動巴士配有續航力長的可充電電池。
Keep a spare battery in your bag when you travel.
旅行時，請在包包裡放一顆備用電池。

zh: 代表、為了（僅用於 on behalf of）
def: Used in on behalf of: acting as the representative of someone, or for their benefit.
用於 on behalf of：作為某人的代表，或為了某人的利益。
ex: I am writing on behalf of the entire sales team.
我謹代表整個業務團隊寫這封信。
Ms. Lee signed the contract on his behalf while he was abroad.
他出國期間，李女士代他簽署了合約。
On behalf of the hotel, I apologise for the delay.
我謹代表本飯店為延誤致歉。
The lawyer acted on the client's behalf during the negotiations.
談判期間，律師代表客戶行事。
We collected donations on behalf of the local hospital.
我們為當地醫院募集捐款。

def: A large room where company directors hold meetings.
公司董事開會的大型會議室。
ex: The directors will meet in the boardroom at ten o'clock.
董事們將在十點於董事會議室開會。
Please book the boardroom if you need to host clients.
如果需要招待客戶，請預約董事會議室。
The boardroom table seats twenty people.
董事會議室的會議桌可容納二十人。
Decisions made in the boardroom affect thousands of employees.
董事會議室裡做的決策會影響數千名員工。
The boardroom has a large screen for video calls.
董事會議室有一面大螢幕可供視訊通話。

note: General term for any room used for meetings; boardroom is the formal room for a board of directors.
泛指任何開會用的房間；boardroom 是董事會用的正式會議室。
A room for meetings of any size or group; boardroom suggests senior management.
任何規模或團體開會的房間；boardroom 暗示高階管理層。

def: A thin printed booklet that gives information about a product, service or place.
介紹產品、服務或地點的薄型印刷小冊子。
ex: Take a brochure from the desk to see our tour options.
請從櫃檯拿一份手冊，看看我們的旅遊方案。
The travel agency sent me a colourful brochure about Spain.
旅行社寄給我一份關於西班牙的彩色手冊。
We are designing a new product brochure for the trade fair.
我們正在為貿易展設計新的產品手冊。
The hotel brochure lists all the facilities and room rates.
飯店手冊列出所有設施和房價。
Her company printed five thousand brochures for the launch event.
她的公司為發表會印了五千份手冊。

note: Usually a few folded pages giving information or an opinion; a brochure is mainly promotional.
通常是幾頁摺頁，提供資訊或意見；brochure 主要用於宣傳。
A single printed sheet, often handed out free; a brochure is usually bound or folded into several pages.
單張印刷品，常免費發送；brochure 通常裝訂或摺成多頁。
A single-sheet advertisement, informal; handed out or posted in public.
單張廣告，較口語；在公共場所發送或張貼。

def: A restaurant in a workplace, school or hospital where people choose their own food and carry it to a table.
設於職場、學校或醫院、由顧客自行取餐的餐廳。
ex: Lunch is served in the staff cafeteria from noon to two.
員工餐廳在中午到兩點供應午餐。
The company cafeteria offers a vegetarian option every day.
公司餐廳每天都提供素食選項。
Our team usually meets in the cafeteria for a quick coffee.
我們團隊通常在餐廳碰面喝杯咖啡。
The hospital cafeteria stays open all night.
醫院的餐廳整晚營業。
Students line up at the campus cafeteria during the lunch break.
午休時間，學生在校園餐廳排隊。

note: British word for a workplace or school dining area; cafeteria is the usual American word.
英式用語，指職場或學校的用餐區；cafeteria 是美式常用字。
A large room for meals at a school or university.
學校或大學中供用餐的大廳。
A cafe is a small public place for drinks and snacks; a cafeteria is a self-service restaurant, often inside an organisation.
cafe 是供應飲料和點心的小型公共場所；cafeteria 是自助式餐廳，常設於機構內。

def: The land and buildings of a university, school or large company.
大學、學校或大型公司的土地與建築群。
ex: The company's main campus has three office buildings and a gym.
公司的主要園區有三棟辦公大樓和一間健身房。
Visitors must register at the gate before entering the campus.
訪客進入園區前必須先在門口登記。
She lives on campus during her first year of study.
她大一那年住在校內。
We recruit new graduates at campus job fairs every autumn.
我們每年秋天在校園徵才博覽會招募應屆畢業生。
A free shuttle runs between the two campuses.
兩個校區之間有免費接駁車往返。

note: The outdoor land around a building; a campus includes the buildings as well as the land.
建築物周圍的戶外土地；campus 則包含建築物與土地。

def: The act of deciding that an event, booking or order will not happen or continue.
決定活動、訂位或訂單不再舉行或繼續。
ex: The airline announced the cancellation of all morning flights.
航空公司宣布取消所有早班航班。
A cancellation fee applies if you change your booking within 24 hours.
如果在二十四小時內更改訂位，需支付取消費。
Because of the cancellation of the keynote speech, the schedule was revised.
由於主題演講取消，議程已作修改。
Please confirm your cancellation by email so we can release the room.
請以電子郵件確認你的取消，讓我們得以釋出房間。
The hotel has a free cancellation policy up to 48 hours before arrival.
這家飯店在入住前四十八小時前可免費取消。

note: Formal; the ending of a contract or employment, rather than an event or booking.
較正式；指合約或雇用關係的終止，而非活動或訂位。

zh: 運輸業者、航空公司；電信業者；保險公司
def: A company that transports goods or passengers, or provides a service such as mobile phone or insurance.
運送貨物或乘客，或提供行動電話、保險等服務的公司。
ex: The carrier will deliver the parcel within two business days.
運送業者會在兩個工作天內送達包裹。
Our main air carrier has added three flights a week to Seoul.
我們主要合作的航空公司每週增加了三班飛往首爾的班機。
Please check with your mobile carrier about roaming charges abroad.
請向你的電信業者查詢國外漫遊費用。
A low-cost carrier flies to Osaka for half the price.
廉價航空飛往大阪的票價只要一半。
The insurance carrier approved the claim last week.
保險公司上週核准了這件理賠。

note: A courier delivers documents or small parcels quickly; a carrier is any company that moves goods or people.
courier 快速遞送文件或小包裹；carrier 是任何運送貨物或人員的公司。
Specifically an air transport company; carrier can also mean sea, road or phone companies.
專指航空運輸公司；carrier 也可指海運、陸運或電信公司。

def: A small container that holds ink or toner and fits inside a printer.
裝有墨水或碳粉、可裝入印表機的小型容器。
ex: The printer stopped because the ink cartridge was empty.
印表機停止運作，因為墨水匣空了。
Order a new toner cartridge before we run out.
請在用完之前訂購新的碳粉匣。
Open the cover and remove the old cartridge carefully.
打開蓋子，小心取出舊的墨水匣。
The supply room keeps spare cartridges for every office printer.
文具室備有每台辦公室印表機所需的備用墨水匣。
Refilled cartridges cost less than original ones.
再填充的墨水匣比原廠的便宜。

zh: 承辦（餐飲）；迎合、滿足需求
def: To provide food and drink for an event; to supply what a particular group of people needs.
為活動提供餐飲；提供特定族群所需的服務。
ex: A local restaurant will cater the staff party on Friday.
當地一家餐廳將承辦週五的員工派對餐點。
The hotel caters to business travellers with fast Wi-Fi and a work desk.
這家飯店以快速無線網路和工作桌來迎合商務旅客。
Our menu caters for vegetarians and guests with food allergies.
我們的菜單照顧到素食者和有食物過敏的賓客。
The conference centre can cater for up to four hundred delegates.
這個會議中心最多可為四百位代表提供餐飲。
The bakery caters mainly to small offices in the area.
這家麵包店主要服務附近的小型辦公室。

note: To make room for or meet someone's needs; not limited to food and drink.
騰出空間或滿足某人需求；不限於餐飲。
Broader; to provide goods or services to customers.
範圍較廣；向顧客提供商品或服務。

def: A person or company that provides food and drink for events.
為活動提供餐飲的人或公司。
ex: We have hired a caterer for the product launch.
我們已為產品發表會聘請了餐飲業者。
The caterer will set up the buffet an hour before guests arrive.
餐飲業者會在賓客抵達前一小時佈置好自助餐。
Please tell the caterer about any dietary requirements by Monday.
請在週一前告知餐飲業者任何飲食需求。
The wedding caterer offers both Western and Chinese menus.
這家婚宴餐飲業者提供西式與中式菜單。
Our regular caterer raised its prices last quarter.
我們固定合作的餐飲業者上一季調漲了價格。

def: An official document that proves a fact, such as a qualification, a birth or a payment.
證明某項事實的正式文件，如資格、出生或款項。
ex: She received a certificate after completing the safety training.
她完成安全訓練後獲頒證書。
Please bring your birth certificate to the visa interview.
請攜帶出生證明參加簽證面談。
The factory holds a quality certificate that must be renewed every three years.
這間工廠持有品質認證，每三年必須更新。
A gift certificate for the spa was the prize.
獎品是一張水療中心的禮券。
Applicants need a teaching certificate issued by the Ministry of Education.
申請人需要教育部核發的教師證。

note: Awarded for finishing a longer course of study; a certificate can be for a short course or to prove any fact.
完成較長學程後頒發；certificate 可為短期課程或證明任何事實。
Any qualification or proof of ability; usually plural and more general than a certificate.
任何資格或能力證明；通常用複數，比 certificate 更籠統。

def: To state officially, usually in writing, that something is true or meets a standard.
正式（通常以書面）聲明某事屬實或符合標準。
ex: The inspector must certify that the building meets fire safety standards.
檢查員必須證明這棟建築物符合消防安全標準。
Our accountant will certify the figures before we submit the report.
我們的會計師會在我們提交報告前核證這些數字。
This document certifies that Mr. Chen completed the course on 5 May.
本文件證明陳先生已於五月五日完成課程。
The lab is certified to test medical equipment.
這間實驗室經認證可以檢測醫療設備。
A notary will certify the copy as a true copy of the original.
公證人會證明這份影本與正本相符。

note: Verify means to check that something is true; certify means to confirm it officially, often in writing.
verify 是查證某事屬實；certify 是正式（常以書面）確認。
Formal; to state or show that something is true, often as a witness (attest to).
較正式；陳述或顯示某事屬實，常如證人般（attest to）。

def: Relating to giving money or help to people in need; kind and generous.
與捐錢或幫助有需要的人有關；仁慈慷慨的。
ex: The company donates part of its profits to charitable causes.
公司把一部分獲利捐給慈善事業。
She works for a charitable organisation that feeds homeless families.
她在一個為無家可歸的家庭提供餐食的慈善組織工作。
Gifts to charitable foundations may be tax deductible.
捐贈給慈善基金會的款項可能可以抵稅。
The firm set up a charitable trust in the founder's name.
公司以創辦人的名義設立了慈善信託。
A charitable event raised funds for the children's hospital.
一場慈善活動為兒童醫院募得了款項。

note: Formal; describes generous giving, often large-scale, to improve society.
較正式；形容慷慨捐助，常為大規模、以改善社會為目的。
Describes an organisation that does not distribute profit to owners; not every nonprofit is charitable.
形容不將利潤分配給所有者的組織；不是所有非營利組織都屬慈善。

def: The place in a shop where you pay; the process of paying or leaving a hotel.
商店中付款的地方；付款或退房的程序。
ex: Checkout is at eleven, but you can leave your luggage at the desk.
退房時間是十一點，但你可以把行李寄放在櫃檯。
There was a long line at the checkout on Saturday afternoon.
週六下午結帳處排了很長的隊。
Customers can pay at the self-service checkout.
顧客可以在自助結帳機付款。
Proceed to checkout to review your order and enter payment details.
請前往結帳頁面檢查訂單並輸入付款資料。
The store opened two extra checkout counters at peak hours.
尖峰時段，商店多開了兩個結帳櫃台。

def: A person whose job is to clean buildings; a substance used for cleaning.
以打掃建築物為業的人；用來清潔的物質。
ex: The office cleaner arrives at six every evening.
辦公室的清潔人員每天傍晚六點到。
A professional cleaner came to wash the carpets.
一位專業清潔人員來清洗地毯。
This all-purpose cleaner removes stains from most surfaces.
這款萬用清潔劑可以去除大部分表面的污漬。
The hotel employs twenty cleaners to prepare rooms before check-in.
飯店雇用二十名清潔人員，在入住前整理房間。
I left my suit at the dry cleaner's on the way to work.
我上班途中把西裝送去乾洗店。

note: American word for a person who cleans and maintains a building.
美式用語，指打掃並維護建築物的人。
Cleans rooms in hotels or homes; in hotels it is the usual job title.
負責打掃飯店或住家的房間；在飯店中是常見職稱。

def: A person who does office work or serves customers at a desk, shop or counter.
從事辦公室文書工作或在櫃檯、店內服務顧客的人。
ex: The hotel desk clerk printed my receipt.
飯店櫃檯人員幫我列印了收據。
A bank clerk will help you open an account.
銀行行員會協助你開戶。
She started as a filing clerk and became office manager.
她從檔案管理員做起，後來成為辦公室經理。
Please ask the sales clerk whether the shirt comes in blue.
請問店員這件襯衫有沒有藍色。
The shipping clerk checks each parcel against the order form.
出貨人員會依訂單核對每個包裹。

note: British term for a person who serves customers in a shop; sales clerk is the American one.
英式用語，指店內服務顧客的人；sales clerk 是美式說法。

def: A person or company that pays a professional or firm for advice or services.
付費向專業人士或公司取得建議或服務的個人或公司。
ex: Our firm has more than fifty clients in the technology sector.
我們事務所在科技業有五十多位客戶。
Please send the proposal to the client by Thursday.
請在週四前將提案寄給客戶。
The law firm protects client confidentiality at all times.
這間律師事務所隨時保護客戶的機密。
A new client called to ask about our consulting fees.
一位新客戶來電詢問我們的顧問費用。
The designer met the client twice before finalising the plan.
設計師在定案前與客戶見了兩次面。

note: A customer buys goods or services, often one time; a client uses professional services, usually over a longer relationship.
customer 購買商品或服務，常為單次；client 使用專業服務，通常關係較長久。
Formal; a regular customer of a shop, restaurant or theatre.
較正式；商店、餐廳或劇院的常客。

def: A place where people receive medical care or advice, usually without staying overnight.
人們接受醫療照護或諮詢的地方，通常不需過夜。
ex: The clinic opens at eight and closes at six on weekdays.
這間診所平日八點開門、六點關門。
She made an appointment at the dental clinic for Tuesday.
她預約了週二到牙醫診所看診。
The company runs a small clinic for employees at its main plant.
公司在主要廠區設有一間供員工使用的小診所。
A free eye clinic will be held at the community centre.
社區活動中心將舉辦免費的眼科門診。
Walk-in clinics treat minor injuries without an appointment.
無需預約的門診可處理輕微傷勢。

note: British; a doctor's or dentist's place of work where patients are seen.
英式用法；醫師或牙醫看診的地點。
A hospital is larger and has beds for patients who stay overnight; a clinic is smaller and usually for day visits.
hospital 較大，設有床位供病人住院；clinic 較小，通常只供當日看診。

def: The act or state of finishing something.
把某事做完的動作或狀態。
ex: The completion of the new terminal is expected in March.
新航廈預計於三月完工。
Upon completion of the course, you will receive a certificate.
完成課程後，你會獲得證書。
The contractor is paid in full on completion of the work.
承包商在工程完成時獲得全額付款。
The project is nearing completion, so the team is preparing handover documents.
專案即將完成，團隊正在準備交接文件。
The form must be returned within a week of completion.
表格填寫完成後必須在一週內交回。

note: The end of an event or process, such as a meeting or talks; completion stresses that the work is finished.
活動或過程（如會議、談判）的結束；completion 強調工作已完成。
Looks similar but means a contest or rivalry between people or companies.
字形相似，但意思是人或公司之間的比賽或競爭。

def: A polite remark that praises someone; to say something that praises someone.
稱讚某人的禮貌話語；說出稱讚某人的話。
ex: The client paid us a compliment on the quick delivery.
客戶稱讚我們出貨迅速。
My manager complimented me on the clear presentation.
我的經理稱讚我簡報條理清楚。
Thank you for the kind compliments about our service.
謝謝你對我們服務的美言。
Customers often compliment the staff on their friendly attitude.
顧客常稱讚員工態度親切。
The champagne is sent with our compliments.
這瓶香檳是我們獻上的心意。

note: Praise can be public and about work or character; a compliment is a short polite remark to a person.
praise 可以是公開的，針對工作或品格；compliment 是對人說的簡短客套話。
Complement (with e) means to go well with or complete something; compliment (with i) means to praise.
complement（有 e）指搭配或使完整；compliment（有 i）指稱讚。

def: Given free as a courtesy by a business; expressing praise.
企業出於禮遇免費提供的；表示讚美的。
ex: Guests receive a complimentary breakfast with every room.
每間客房的住客都附贈早餐。
The airline offers complimentary drinks in first class.
航空公司在頭等艙免費提供飲料。
She gave a complimentary review of the new software.
她對這套新軟體給了正面的評價。
Please take a complimentary ticket to the exhibition.
請收下這張展覽的招待券。
A complimentary shuttle runs between the hotel and the station.
飯店與車站之間有免費接駁車往返。

note: Everyday word; complimentary is the polite word for something a business gives at no charge.
日常用語；complimentary 是商家免費贈送時較禮貌的用詞。
Informal phrase for food or drink a restaurant or bar gives free.
口語說法，指餐廳或酒吧免費招待的餐飲。
Complementary means going well together or completing each other, as in complementary skills; it has nothing to do with free.
complementary 指互相搭配或互補，如互補的技能；與「免費」無關。

def: To do what a rule, law or request says you must do.
依照規則、法律或要求所規定的去做。
ex: All suppliers must comply with our environmental standards.
所有供應商都必須遵守我們的環保標準。
The factory was fined for failing to comply with safety regulations.
這間工廠因未遵守安全法規而被罰款。
We will comply with your request and send the files today.
我們會依你的要求，今天就寄出檔案。
Employees are required to comply with the company's travel policy.
員工必須遵守公司的差旅政策。
Does the new packaging comply with the labelling rules?
新包裝符合標示規定嗎？

note: Obey is used with a person or command and sounds more personal; comply with is used with rules and requests.
obey 用於人或命令，語氣較個人；comply with 用於規定與要求。
To match a standard or pattern; comply stresses doing what is required.
符合某標準或模式；comply 強調做到所要求的事。
Abide by means to accept and follow a rule or decision.
abide by 指接受並遵守規定或決定。

def: Meant to be kept secret and shared only with certain people.
應當保密、只與特定人士分享的。
ex: Please keep this information strictly confidential.
請嚴格保密這項資訊。
The file is marked confidential and is locked in the safe.
這份檔案標示為機密，鎖在保險箱裡。
Employees sign an agreement not to share confidential client data.
員工須簽署協議，不得洩漏客戶機密資料。
Her salary details are confidential and known only to HR.
她的薪資細節屬於機密，只有人資部門知道。
A confidential email was sent to the wrong address by mistake.
一封機密電子郵件被誤寄到錯誤的地址。

note: Private means personal and not for the public; confidential is used for business or official information.
private 指個人、不對外公開；confidential 多用於商業或官方資訊。
Hidden from nearly everyone; confidential information may still be shared with permitted people.
對幾乎所有人隱瞞；confidential 的資訊仍可與獲准的人分享。
Officially marked as secret by a government or military.
經政府或軍方正式列為機密。
Confident means sure of yourself or of something; confidential means secret.
confident 是對自己或某事有信心；confidential 是機密。

def: A statement or document that says something is true, agreed or booked.
表示某事屬實、已同意或已預訂的聲明或文件。
ex: You will receive a booking confirmation by email within an hour.
你會在一小時內以電子郵件收到訂位確認。
We are waiting for written confirmation from the supplier.
我們正在等供應商的書面確認。
Please bring your confirmation number to the check-in desk.
請攜帶你的確認編號到報到櫃檯。
The confirmation of his promotion was announced on Friday.
他升遷的確認消息在週五公布。
Reply to this message as confirmation that you will attend the meeting.
請回覆此訊息，確認你會出席會議。

note: Verification means checking that something is true; confirmation says it is settled, agreed or booked.
verification 是查證某事屬實；confirmation 是表示已確定、同意或預訂。
Shows that something was received; it does not necessarily say it is approved or correct.
表示已收到；不一定表示已核准或正確。

def: To match a rule, standard or expected pattern of behaviour.
符合某項規定、標準或預期的行為模式。
ex: All products must conform to international safety standards.
所有產品都必須符合國際安全標準。
The software update was designed to conform with the new data law.
這次軟體更新是為了符合新的資料法規而設計。
Visitors are expected to conform to the dress code at the club.
俱樂部要求訪客遵守服裝規定。
The design does not conform to the client's specifications.
這個設計不符合客戶的規格。
New recruits quickly conform to the company's way of working.
新進員工很快就適應公司的工作方式。

family.zh: 符合性（常見於標準規範）

note: Comply stresses doing what is required; conform stresses matching a standard or pattern.
comply 強調做到所要求的事；conform 強調符合標準或模式。
Everyday word; to do what a rule or example says.
日常用語；照規定或範例去做。
Looks similar but means to say or show that something is true or certain.
字形相似，但意思是確認或證實某事屬實。

def: By a large amount; to a great degree.
數量很多；程度很大。
ex: Sales rose considerably after we changed the packaging.
我們更換包裝後，銷售額大幅成長。
The new model is considerably cheaper than the old one.
新款比舊款便宜許多。
Delivery times have improved considerably since we switched carriers.
自從我們更換運輸業者後，送貨時間已大幅改善。
The two proposals differ considerably in cost.
這兩份提案的成本差異很大。
The hotel was considerably busier than we expected during the fair.
展覽期間，飯店比我們預期的繁忙許多。

note: Stresses that the change is important or measurable; considerably stresses the size of the amount.
強調變化重要或可衡量；considerably 強調幅度大。
Formal; by a large amount, often used for figures and changes.
較正式；幅度大，常用於數字與變動。
Used before or after verbs, as in greatly improved; not before comparatives like cheaper.
用在動詞前後，如 greatly improved；不用在 cheaper 這類比較級前。
Considerate means thoughtful about other people's feelings; it is not the adjective of considerably.
considerate 指體貼他人感受；不是 considerably 對應的形容詞。
